parts.name: ContextMenuRoot
parts.description: Holds the context menu's open state and shares it with the parts inside it. It is a `MenuRoot`. Renders no element.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the menu is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control the menu.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the menu is open at first, when it isn't controlled. Default: false.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new state after the browser or a part opened or closed the menu. It is called in a change of its own, after the menu's: a request it starts, or a handler that is itself an action, doesn't hold the menu.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A disabled context menu doesn't open, and the browser's own menu shows instead.

parts.name: ContextMenuButton
parts.description: A button inside ContextMenuTrigger that opens the same menu by click, tap or keyboard.

parts.name: ContextMenuTrigger
parts.description: The area that opens the menu: on a right-click at the pointer, on a long press at the finger, and on the context-menu key or Shift+F10 below the focused element inside it. It holds the empty, fixed-position element the popup is anchored to. The area is keyboard focusable.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the context menu is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the menu is open.

parts.name: ContextMenuPopup
parts.description: The menu: a `MenuPopup`, an element with `popover="auto"` and the `menu` role, placed below and to the right of the point it opened at. A submenu's popup is also a `ContextMenuPopup`, declared inside its parent's.

props.name: side
props.default: "bottom"; "right" for a submenu and in a vertical menubar
props.description: Which side of the point the popup sits on. The browser flips it when it doesn't fit.

props.name: align
props.description: Which way from the point the popup extends, along the side.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: The gap between the point and the popup, in pixels.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: How far the popup is moved along the side from its `align` position, in pixels.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of the point the popup is on: the `side` asked for, then the side the browser placed it on once open.

parts.name: ContextMenuItem
parts.description: An action in the menu: a `MenuItem`. Choosing it runs its `onClick` and, by default, closes the menu.

props.name: variant
props.description: Use `destructive` for an item that deletes or discards something.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A disabled item can't be chosen, and the arrow keys skip it. Default: false.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Whether choosing the item closes the menu and every menu it is nested in. Default: true.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-highlighted
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item has the highlight.

parts.name: ContextMenuLinkItem
parts.description: A menu item that is a link: a `MenuLinkItem`. Enter follows it.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Whether following the link closes the menu. Default: false.

dataAttributes.name: data-highlighted
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item has the highlight.

parts.name: ContextMenuCheckboxItem
parts.description: An item that toggles a setting on and off: a `MenuCheckboxItem`. Choosing it leaves the menu open by default.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the item is checked. Pass it with `onCheckedChange` to control it.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Whether the item is checked at first, when it isn't controlled. Default: false.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the item is chosen. It is called in a change of its own, after the item's: a request it starts, or a handler that is itself an action, doesn't hold the menu.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A disabled item can't be chosen, and the arrow keys skip it. Default: false.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Whether choosing the item closes the menu. Default: false.

dataAttributes.name: data-checked
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item is checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-highlighted
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item has the highlight.

dataAttributes.name: data-unchecked
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item is not checked.

parts.name: ContextMenuRadioGroup
parts.description: Groups radio items and holds which one is chosen: a `MenuRadioGroup`.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the chosen item. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the group.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value chosen at first, when the group isn't controlled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the item's value when a radio item is chosen. It is called in a change of its own, after the group's: a request it starts, or a handler that is itself an action, doesn't hold the menu.

parts.name: ContextMenuRadioItem
parts.description: An item that chooses one value of its radio group: a `MenuRadioItem`. Choosing it leaves the menu open by default.

props.name: value
props.description: The value the item stands for in its group.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A disabled item can't be chosen, and the arrow keys skip it. Default: false.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Whether choosing the item closes the menu. Default: false.

dataAttributes.name: data-checked
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item is the group's chosen one.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-highlighted
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item has the highlight.

dataAttributes.name: data-unchecked
dataAttributes.description: Present when another item, or none, is chosen.

parts.name: ContextMenuGroup
parts.description: Groups related items: a `MenuGroup`. A `ContextMenuGroupLabel` inside it names the group.

parts.name: ContextMenuGroupLabel
parts.description: A label for its group: a `MenuGroupLabel`, which the group's `aria-labelledby` points at.

parts.name: ContextMenuSeparator
parts.description: A line between items or groups, with the `separator` role: a `MenuSeparator`.

parts.name: ContextMenuSubmenuRoot
parts.description: A menu inside the context menu: a `MenuSubmenuRoot`. It holds a `ContextMenuSubmenuTrigger` and the submenu's own `ContextMenuPopup`. Renders no element.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the submenu is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the submenu is open at first, when it isn't controlled. Default: false.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the submenu opens or closes. It is called in a change of its own, after the submenu's: a request it starts, or a handler that is itself an action, doesn't hold the submenu.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A disabled submenu doesn't open. Default: false.

parts.name: ContextMenuSubmenuTrigger
parts.description: The item that opens the submenu: a `MenuSubmenuTrigger`. It opens on hover, on a press, and on ArrowRight, Enter and Space.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A disabled trigger doesn't open its submenu. Default: false.

props.name: openOnHover
props.description: Whether resting the pointer on the trigger opens the submenu. Default: true.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long the pointer rests on the trigger before the submenu opens, in milliseconds. Default: 100.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: How long after the pointer leaves, other than towards the submenu, before it closes, in milliseconds. Default: 0.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the trigger is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-highlighted
dataAttributes.description: Present while the trigger has the highlight.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the submenu is open.
